results.content:
### What if a book is not in the catalog?

Add it by hand, with your own photo of the cover. It behaves like any other book in your library — on shelves, in collections, in your reading stats.

### Does it work for e-books and audiobooks?

Yes. Mark the format, and progress is counted the way you read it: pages for paper, percent for e-books, minutes for audiobooks. A library book or an audiobook can count as read without being on your shelves.

### What happens if I change phones?

Sign in to your account on the new phone and your library, reading history and notes come back. Everything is saved to your account, not only to the device.

### Is my library private? [...] ### Books in your language

Search 122 million books across library catalogs and book databases worldwide. The app itself comes in 20 languages.

### Your library is safe

Create an account and your library is saved and synced across your devices. A new phone doesn’t mean starting over.

## A look inside

Five more screens you’ll keep coming back to: your library, your notes, your goals, what to read next and what you’re reading now.

## Everything a reader needs

Track your reading, keep your books in order and stay on top of your goals. [...] ## Frequently asked questions

### Is Bookella free?

Yes. The free version holds 50 books and 3 collections, and the timer, reading sessions, goals, notes, loans and scanning have no limits. There are no ads in the app. Premium removes the limits on books and collections and adds detailed statistics, photos in notes, text recognition from photos, PDF export of notes and AI book picks. Text recognition and AI picks can be tried for free first. Premium comes as a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. If a subscription ends, nothing you created is locked.

### Which devices does it run on?

iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets. One account keeps your library in sync on all of them.
